## Appearance

Matthew Cuthbert is depicted with long gray hair framing his face. In repose, he wears a gentle, kindly smile that gives him a peaceful, sleeping appearance.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)_

## Personality

Matthew Cuthbert is an exceptionally shy, quiet, and taciturn man who is considered odd by those who know of him. Reluctant to interact with strangers or speak out, he is nevertheless remembered as a deeply kind individual who offers love and sympathy.

## History

Matthew Cuthbert was raised by a shy, silent father who built a home far away from other people, and [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) grew up to be the first person to offer love and sympathy to [Anne](../character/anne.md) Shirley's starved childhood. When he went to the station expecting to pick up an orphan boy to help on the farm, he was met instead by [Anne](../character/anne.md) and decided to bring her to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to let his sister [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) handle the mistake. [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) quietly advocated for keeping [Anne](../character/anne.md) and gave her simple delights, such as visiting her room to gently persuade her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) so she could stay, and gifting her a package of chocolate sweets. After [Anne](../character/anne.md) completed her studies at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) spent a tender final evening with her before dying suddenly from the shock of reading about the Abbey Bank failure.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER I. ## Quotes

> “Well now, you’ll have to punish her,” said Matthew, reaching for his hat. “I’ve nothing to do with it, remember. You warned me off yourself.”
>
> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P25](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0025)

> “Well now, I can’t seem to,” said Matthew, as he opened the yard gate to let the cows through. “It’s only that I’m getting old, Anne, and keep forgetting it. Well, well, I’ve always worked pretty hard and I’d rather drop in harness.”
>
> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P39](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0039)

> "I reckon she ought to be punished a little. But don’t be too hard on her, Marilla. Recollect she hasn’t ever had anyone to teach her right. You’re—you’re going to give her something to eat, aren’t you?"

> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P3](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0003)

> "It’ll have to be done sooner or later, you know, for Marilla’s a dreadful determined woman—dreadful determined, Anne. Do it right off, I say, and have it over."

> "That’s right—that’s right, Anne. But don’t tell Marilla I said anything about it. She might think I was putting my oar in and I promised not to do that."

> — Matthew Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P19](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0019)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--matthew-cuthbert.md)

[Matthew](../character/matthew.md) serves as a gentle advocate and sympathizer for [Anne](../character/anne.md) from the moment she arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). He frequently takes her side, such as quietly visiting her room to convince her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) so she can be forgiven, and gifting her treats like chocolate sweets. The two share a tender closeness until Matthew's sudden death from shock, which leaves [Anne](../character/anne.md) in deep grief.

- Friend of — sympathizes with her and takes her part  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P2](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0002)</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--matthew-cuthbert.md)

[Matthew](../character/matthew.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) are brother and sister who live together at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Though they initially agree to adopt an orphan boy to help [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) on the farm, they must navigate the surprise of receiving [Anne](../character/anne.md) instead. While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) focuses on strict discipline and proper upbringing, [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) acts as a softer counterbalance, encouraging [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to raise the girl and intervening when [Anne](../character/anne.md) is at odds with her.

- Sibling of — brother and sister living together at Green Gables  _(ended v1)_  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), +7 more</sub>
